name: What should I look for in an exterior painting contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in an exterior painting contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an exterior painting contractor, look for proof of proper licensing and insurance, a portfolio of past work, and customer references. It's also important to ensure they provide a detailed written estimate that outlines all aspects of the job, including surface preparation, the number of paint coats, and cleanup procedures. In our case, being a local company serving DFW and surrounding cities like Aledo and Allen, we understand specific regional requirements and material considerations, offering localized expertise.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for licensed and insured contractors with a portfolio, references, and a detailed estimate. Local companies often have specific regional expertise.
